assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: finished landscape background for a school chapter in a German learning visual novel, 3:2 landscape. A believable small German secondary school classroom, empty, warm morning light from tall windows on the right, a few orderly paired wooden desks and chairs, muted sage-painted lower walls and cream plaster above, a real dark green chalkboard at the back with absolutely NO writing, cork noticeboard with blank paper, school bags on hooks, modest book shelf and one plant. Keep the left foreground quiet for a waist-up character overlay, with clear depth and sensible perspective. Traditional gouache and watercolor background illustration with delicate visible pencil construction and selective ink lines, restrained pigment, paper grain, human irregular brush edges, calm editorial illustration, like a carefully drawn animation background. Clear intentional composition, accurate straight architecture and consistent desk/chair geometry; natural unembellished objects. Warm ochre, pale sage, dusty blue, cream. Avoid hyper-detailed fantasy clutter, over-saturated green, plastic rendering, shiny 3D, cinematic bloom, repeated warped furniture, fake text, people, watermarks, UI and logos. Cozy and age-appropriate for 10–15-year-old students.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: finished landscape background for the park chapter of a German-learning visual novel, 3:2 landscape. A quiet believable German village park on an early summer afternoon. View from near a small wooden picnic table at lower right across a gently curving gravel path, a single ordinary wooden bench next to a birch tree, lawn with daisies, a shallow pond on right middle distance, village roofs partly visible behind shrubs, a small red ball on lawn and one open picnic basket on the table. No people. Left foreground has simple lawn and soft shadows, clear space for a waist-up character overlay. Traditional watercolor and gouache illustration with hand-controlled pencil and selective ink outlines, textured cold-pressed paper, purposeful broad brush masses and restrained fine detail, slight natural asymmetry. Coherent perspective, real bench construction, botanically plausible tree branches and leaves represented as painterly grouped shapes. Late afternoon gentle warm cream light, sage and olive greens, dusty blue pond, muted terracotta accents. Avoid excessive decoration, repetitive generic flowers, artificial glow, photorealistic or plastic 3D rendering, malformed objects, text, signage, watermark, UI. A carefully composed professional hand-painted animation background with visible craft.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image is the established Mia character expression sheet; preserve her exact identity and outfit. Make a NEW supplementary character sprite atlas with exactly THREE equal portrait cells in ONE horizontal row, overall canvas 2:1 landscape, individual portrait cell ratio 2:3. Same shoulder-length chestnut brown hair with short high side ponytail on viewer right, pink hair bow, amber eyes, white short sleeve school blouse with pink piping and necktie, small portion of blue skirt at bottom. Front-facing waist-up portraits, head size and torso alignment matched across all three cells, safe transparent margins in each cell. Left: playful WINK, one eye closed, friendly small smile, one open hand gently raised near shoulder. Middle: SURPRISED by a new discovery, both eyes wider and mouth slightly open, eyebrows raised, relaxed non-alarm posture. Right: PROUD AND RELIEVED, gentle closed-mouth smile with eyes open, hands softly clasped at chest, quiet sense of achievement rather than loud cheering. Consistent polished 2D anime visual novel line work and restrained cel shading matching reference. THREE portraits only. Actual transparent background alpha=0 outside characters, keep all character pixels fully opaque including white blouses; no white panels, no grid lines, no checkerboard drawing, no lettering, no watermark. Do not reuse the same expression in all cells. Age-appropriate classroom adventure.

transparency_refinement: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided 3-expression Mia sprite sheet. Remove the ENTIRE colored brown/gray/blue background and make it truly transparent with alpha zero. The outside of all three characters, between their hair and arms and behind their bodies, must be transparent, not translucent color. Keep every character pixel opaque, especially white shirts, skin and hair highlights. Preserve the exact existing canvas size and 3-column single-row layout, the existing character positions, expression, scale and pose. No new art, no text, no frame. Only remove the background. This must be a production transparent PNG for compositing over a classroom scene.
